gappers.catalyst: Giving back Monday's +22%/+20%-style Huang-reinstatement relief rally as the AI complex de-risks
gappers.catalyst_detail: No company-specific news. CRWV closed +22% Monday (second-best Nasdaq-100 performer behind NVDA) purely on Huang's reinstatement, because Nvidia is CRWV's chip supplier, an equity investor, and has agreed to buy back capacity CRWV cannot sell. Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO on Mon 2026-11-23 after resigning Nov 11, triggering one of the rarest rallies on record (only 6 of the Nasdaq-100 fell; Nasdaq Composite +6.5%, QQQ ~+7%, XLK ~+9%). On Tue 2026-11-24 that relief trade is being given back: Nasdaq opened -1.4/-1.6% and extended to ~-2%, NVDA -6%, with fresh US tariffs on China, renewed Fed rate-hike concern, pending US inflation data, and newly-listed Anthropic breaking below its $83 IPO price (-6.5% to $82) as the drags. CRWV had lost 35% between Nov 11 (Huang's resignation) and Friday's close, so Monday recovered only part of that.
gappers.why: Pure vendor-financing beta. The market treats CRWV as a levered call option on Nvidia's willingness to backstop neoclouds; Huang's return restored that backstop premium Monday and today's broad AI de-risking strips it back out. Nothing about CRWV's own contracts changed in either direction.
gappers.impact: Reads as mean-reversion inside a severe downtrend, not a new leg. Monday's 11.4M shares was ~7x the 20-day average of 1.6M - a buying climax, which makes a give-back the base case rather than a surprise. Sector read-through is total: NBIS (rank 2) and IREN closed +20% and +24% Monday and NBIS is down a near-identical -7.0% today, so this is one trade, not two. Price is 49% below the 200-SMA ($87.53) and 67.8% off the 52-week high.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Nothing to displace - the account is 100% cash, 0 positions, with all 3 weekly trades unspent, so the real cost is the correlation slot, not a holding. CRWV, NBIS, AMKR, STM, RKLB, OKLO, KLIC and LUNR are all one AI-infra/high-beta factor right now, so taking CRWV would consume the only entry the >0.75 correlation gate allows from this entire list. It cannot clear the setup gate anyway: price is far below the 200-SMA, failing the long-bias filter, and with a 14.6% ATR the mandatory 10% trailing stop sits inside one ATR of noise, so a 2:1 R:R is unreachable at any sane stop distance.
gappers.horizon_reason: The move is headline-driven give-back of a 1-day relief spike with no durable thesis; ATR(14) is 14.6% of price, so a multi-day hold is a volatility bet, not a swing thesis.
